summary.name: Coluracetam
summary.one_liner: Coluracetam is an open source macOS Markdown editor and reader with live preview, Finder Quick Look support, and PDF/HTML export.
use_cases: editing Markdown files with a rendered preview
reading .md files without opening an editor
previewing Markdown in Finder via Quick Look
lightweight writing of plain-text notes on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: Coluracetam is a Markdown reader and editor for macOS. It opens and saves plain .md and .markdown files directly. It shows a live rendered preview alongside monospace source while editing. It adds Finder integration so Quick Look previews and thumbnails show rendered Markdown. It can export the rendered document to PDF or HTML. The page says it works without accounts or setup.
notable: Finder Quick Look and thumbnail rendering for Markdown files
Live preview while editing monospace source
Open source under the MIT license
caveats: Only macOS is listed; the page names macOS Tahoe 26 as the supported version
Page gives little detail beyond the listed features
